source_text: Bioethicists such as J. Steven Svoboda maintain that such non-therapeutic interventions infringe core human rights to physical inviolability and self-determination, as outlined in documents like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the Convention on the Rights of the Child, which prioritize protection from unnecessary harm.
